en.t: This has really been a great help...

units.source_text: 和一个人的时候不同，早上可以慢悠悠的，还能提早两个小时收工……

en.t: Unlike when I was alone, I can take it easy in the morning, and even finish work two hours earlier...

units.source_text: 我想，将来跟组织上说说，再弄点儿家里干的活……

en.t: I think someday I will talk to the organization and get a little more work I can do at home...
Then I can save up a little money...

units.source_text: 那样的话，就能买镜子、收音机什么的了……”

en.t: If I do that, I will be able to buy things like a mirror and a radio...
